theorem: If both sigma orientations are admitted and a separately supplied physical cosmological-term sign bridge is total, nonzero and odd, then its image contains both signs. W219-corrected W211 and CC-1 supply no independent selector, so sigma alone does not force a unique dark-energy sign.

premises.statement: The sigma carrier is the two-element orientation torsor {-1,+1}, with both values admitted and no internal selector.
premises.reopener: A source- or action-owned selector that excludes one orientation.

premises.statement: The supplied bridge to the sign of a nonzero physical cosmological term is total and odd under sigma reversal.
premises.reopener: A partial, zero-valued, constant/even or otherwise non-odd physical bridge.

premises.statement: W211's invariant-space jump is retained only as a 14-frame proxy and is not promoted to a native interacting theorem.
premises.reopener: A valid native interacting derivation that replaces the proxy.

premises.statement: W219's unique native compact grading is kinematic and does not select an external sigma orientation; the dynamical good-stable stabilizer remains undefined.
premises.reopener: A source-owned interacting vacuum, physical state, observable algebra and dynamical isotropy calculation that supplies a selector.

premises.statement: The adjoint VEV has no gauge-invariant linear map to an absolute cosmological term.
premises.reopener: A differently typed source-owned scalar map.

premises.statement: The unique invariant bilinear form carries an undeclared real coefficient whose sign is free.
premises.reopener: A source- or action-owned coefficient with a proved sign.

premises.statement: The degree-at-most-four lock constrains only a shift relative to a free constant.
premises.reopener: A complete physical vacuum-energy accounting that fixes the additive constant and all other contributions.

premises.statement: Degree six admits an exact positive-energy stationary minimum, so the quartic shift result is not universal.
premises.reopener: A source-owned degree bound or other law excluding the counterexample class.

allowed_claims: conditional two-sign survival under the typed odd nonzero bridge
sigma-only physical-sign nonselection under the frozen premises
correction-aware separation of kinematic grading uniqueness from dynamical orientation selection
exact non-admission loci for the Killing and low-degree-potential sign shortcuts
forbidden_claims: construction or source ownership of the sigma-to-physical-Lambda bridge
prediction of the observed cosmological-constant sign or dark-energy equation of state
unconditional GU theorem, confirmation or falsification
